title: OpenAssistant Conversations - Democratizing Large Language Model Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the fine-tuned model's political leanings using a subset of the Political Compass test by standardizing prompts, drawing multiple samples, and using majority voting to determine the final answer.
Employing the automated Detoxify model to detect and measure 'identity attack' scores (toxicity targeting certain identities) across retained and deleted messages in the dataset.
Conducting a community survey via Google Forms to measure the demographic distribution (e.g., gender, age, education level) of dataset contributors and identify representation biases.
